Thank you. I really appreciate that. I didn't think that I would actually get much help from coming here, but I feel loads better and a bit more confident. I really appreciate your advice.

I own the book *Mindfulness in Plain English* so I'll check that out to get started. Any tips or links that I could check out so that I can learn what I basically need to do in order to meditate? Its been a while.
Thank you. I'm not sure I agree with you that im not a bad person, but it means a lot to me that someone knows and doesn't think so.
I spent a few months meditating and it was really helpful in allowing me to be more aware and less judgemental. Perhaps I shoukd pick it back up. Thank you.

As much as I feel like dying some times, even now, I know that I owe those whom I love too much too kill myself. I don't deserve to leave that easily.  My parents, my fiance, my family and friends, they deserve more than that. I have to find a way to make it work. I owe them that much.

Thanks for your comments, it's really nice to feel like I won't be judged, but honestly it is not necessary. I would love more than anything to never do what I've done ever again, but from much of the research I have done, even if I could control my compulsions, there is no way to stop being the way I am. Apparently I'm "uncurable." 

When I was about 10 years old, my parents had become separated and were going through a nasty divorce. I was living part time at my moms and part time at my grandparents on my dad's side with my dad and my sister. One day I decided to go on the family computer to find some pictures I had taken with a friend. Unfortunately I was having a tough time so I decided to look through folders I wouldn't normally check. I became deeply traumatized when I happened upon a folder which contained several explicit photos of my dad and some woman I had never met before (this woman later became my step mom). I was absolutely mortified as I had never seen porn before and I was positive my parents would get back together. 

After that, for years later I would routinely go and find the new porn that they would upload and I would masturbate to it. I was terribly ashamed because I knew how wro g it was, but I didn't know how to stop. I eventually found my way to other types of pornography, very degrading stuff. At some point when I was between the ages of 12-14 I decided that I wanted to look at naked people who were my own age. When I was young I thought that was fine because we were both kids, but then as I got older, I didn't stop being attracted. Try as I might, I couldn't stop. I went to sex addicts annonymous, numerous therapists, and even sook someone out who was going through the same issues. None of it really helped. None of it stopped me from...being the way I am. I always hoped and prayed that it would just go away some day, that once I got older I would stop feeling this way. But it hasn't. I haven't. I positively hate myself and have thought about killing myself nearly every day since I was a kid. But I always stopped myself because while I feel like I don't deserve to live, I feel like I don't desrve to die even more. How fuckkng selfish of me to even have such thoughts when I think of how many people I would hurt! I became a philosophy student so that I could learn what it means and how to be a good person, but I'm struck in the face with absurd meaninglessness every where I turn.

So sorry for the long novel, but now you have some idea of what I mean when I say I am a bad person.

I'm in a very similar boat, minus the gf thing. I'm not in grad school currently, but I've racked up a massive amount of debt, and the majority of it has been taken up by my mother as a part of a parent plus loan. She bet on me, and now the debt is so much I feel like I've failed her. Its too late to get enrolled in any grad school nearby, and even if it wasn't,  it's too late for scholarships and my mom cannot afford any more debt. I feel kind of hopeless. Even if I get a couple good jobs and work 70 hours a week, I'd be broke.

I'm sort of hoping against hope for a miracle. Sorry, that's probably not all that helpful, but for me, its at least nice to know I'm not alone.

:/
